test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Plodded.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer to fill in **blank number 2** is **"plodded."**
 
• **"Plodded"** means to walk heavily and slowly, and it fits in the context of the sentence as the speaker had just finished a messy job and was likely feeling tired or sluggish.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• After a long day of hiking, I **plodded **back to my tent and collapsed on my sleeping bag.
 
• The old horse **plodded **along the path, taking slow and deliberate steps.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

Correct Paragraph:__ *(1) *__Skinning__ *a bear encased in fat is a very messy job, and as I **(2)** __**plodded**__ back to the Rest House for a hot bath and a late breakfast, I met a very (3)_________ Forest Guard, whose headquarters were at Dabidhura. Being in urgent need of bear’s fat for his father, who was (4)_________ with rheumatism, he was hurrying to try to get a share of the fat when he ran into a herd of (5)________ cattle, followed by a boy who informed him that a tiger had killed one of his cows.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Floated" **means to move lightly and gracefully through the air or water without touching the surface. It is not an appropriate option to fill in this blank as the speaker had just finished a messy job and would not be moving lightly or gracefully.

 
 
• Example: The leaves **floated **down from the trees and landed on the ground.
 
 
 
• **"Fluttered"** means to flap or wave quickly and lightly, which is not an appropriate option to fill in this blank as it suggests a quick and light movement, whereas the speaker is likely feeling heavy and sluggish.
 
 
• Example: The butterflies **fluttered **their wings and flew away.
 
 
 
• **"Pranced"** means to move in a lively and springy way, which is not an appropriate option to fill in this blank as the speaker is not likely to be moving in a lively or springy way after finishing a messy job.
 
 
• Example: The horse **pranced **around the field, enjoying its freedom.
